data.body:
[P2] Accept supported active statuses for deadline victims

A victim independently proven paused at the behavior cutoff is normalized to `PAUSED` by `_active_status_at_cutoff`, and its later stop can establish complete history coverage. This expectation nevertheless excludes `PAUSED`, so an otherwise valid deadline or peer-recovery case fails the status assertion. Include the supported active cutoff statuses in this oracle and add an adjudication regression using the binding-derived expectation with a paused victim.
